newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium futures end higher in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium futures end higher in all months.

text.p: All Tokyo aluminium futures closed higher on Wednesday, reflecting the yen's falls against the dollar and firmer LME prices overnight, traders said.
TOCOM aluminium ended 0.2 to 3.0 yen firmer, with the benchmark April 1998 contract ending up 0.2 yen at 208.7 yen per kg. The day's estimated volume was 7,936 lots.
All contracts gained during the morning session, as local investors triggered buying, traders said. The buying orders continued until the afternoon but then lost momentum, they said.
"The market has been oversold recently, and short-covering by local investors also supported the price gains," a brokerage house trader said.
Trading is likely to remain quiet throughout this week, due to Japan's "Golden Week" holidays, traders said.
